Run an SQL statement against a dataset

Source: R/vector.R
execute_sql.Rd

Run an SQL statement against a dataset

Usage

execute_sql(x, sql, dialect = NULL)

Arguments

x

A GDALDataset object.

sql

The statement.

dialect

The SQL dialect: NULL for the driver's own, "SQLITE" for GDAL's SQLite dialect, "OGRSQL" for GDAL's built-in one.

Value

A GDALLayer holding the result set, or NULL for a statement that returns none. The result set is released when the layer is garbage collected, or when the dataset is closed.

Examples

ds <- gdal_open(system.file("extdata/test.gpkg", package = "GDAL7"))
read_vector(execute_sql(ds, "SELECT name FROM places WHERE population > 1e6"))
#>   OGC_FID      name
#> 1       1 Melbourne
#> 2       2    Sydney
#> 3       3     Perth
gdal_close(ds)
